name: Log Windows Startup Programs
description: Append the list of programs Windows starts at logon, with the command and registry or folder location each comes from, to a log on a schedule. Diffing two snapshots shows a program that quietly added itself to startup.
commandTemplate: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name, Command, Location | Out-File -Append '{{logPath}}'"

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where to append the snapshot on each run. Each run adds the whole list again, so compare the latest block with the one before it to spot a new entry.
